name: banksphere-banking-system
description: Bank Sphere — Modern Banking System powered by C++ Binary Search Tree and Separate Chaining Hash Table

scripts.build:cpp: cd BankSphere && g++ -std=c++17 src/api_bridge.cpp src/bst/AccountBST.cpp src/bst/AccountNode.cpp src/hashtable/AuthTable.cpp src/hashtable/BucketNode.cpp src/hashtable/CredentialNode.cpp src/utils/FileUtils.cpp -Iinclude -o BankSphereBridge.exe && g++ -std=c++17 src/main.cpp src/bst/AccountBST.cpp src/bst/AccountNode.cpp src/hashtable/AuthTable.cpp src/hashtable/BucketNode.cpp src/hashtable/CredentialNode.cpp src/modules/AdminModule.cpp src/modules/CustomerModule.cpp src/modules/StaffModule.cpp src/utils/FileUtils.cpp -Iinclude -o BankSphere.exe
